description: A company must deliver Deliver_i units of its product at the end of the i-th month. Material produced during a month can be delivered either at the end of the same month or can be stored as inventory and delivered at the end of a subsequent month. There is a storage cost of StorageCost dollars per month for each unit of product held in inventory. The year begins with zero inventory. If the company produces x_i units in month i and x_{i+1} units in month i+1, it incurs a cost of SwitchCost |x_{i+1} - x_i| dollars, reflecting the cost of switching to a new production level. Assume that inventory left at the end of the year has no value and does not incur any storage cost. The company wants to minimize the total cost of the production and inventory schedule over the next T months.

Deliver.definition: Units of product to deliver at the end of month i

StorageCost.definition: Cost to hold one unit of product in inventory for one month

SwitchCost.definition: Cost per unit change in production level between consecutive months

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of the production and inventory schedule over the T months, including inventory storage costs and production switching costs."
